content: Muuka-Mutagatiifu agishoga Baranaaba na Saawulo
Omu chigusho ch'abemeezi b'eAntiyokiya, mwaliiri abaleebi n'abigiriza: Baranaaba, Simeooni oyirikwa Mwiragula, Lukiyo w'eKureene, Manaheni walembwaga haguma na mwami Heroode
, na Saawulo.
Lusiku luguma, oku bali baharamya Nnaweerhu n'oguchiibuza kulya, Muuka-Mutagatiifu aderha ntya: «Mumpirire eburhambi Baranaaba na Saawulo gukulikirana n'akaasi nabahamagaliire.»
Bayuusize guchiibuza kulya, basaliira, babalambuulira kw'amaboko, banabarhuma bagende gukolera Nnamahanga.
Baranaaba na Saawulo baabala oMwazi Mwinja eGipuro
Muuka-Mutagatiifu abeere arhuma Baranaaba na Saawulo, bayandagalira omu gishagala ch'eSelukiya. Mw'echo gishagala, barhoola echombo, babalamira oku chizimba ch'eGipuro.
Babeere baahika omu gishagala ch'eSalami, baabala omwazi gwa Nnamahanga omu masinagoogi m'aBayaahudi. Baliiri haguma na Yohaana oyirikwa Mariko nka murhabaazi waabo.
Babeere bamazungula omu chizimba chooshi guhika omu gishagala ch'ePafo, babugaana mo mukurungu muguma w'oMuyaahudi. Oyoola mukurungu aliiri muleebi w'obubeeshi oyirikwa Bara-Yeesu.
Aliiri murhabaazi wa Serugiyo Paawulo, munyabwenge na murhegesi w'eGipuro. Oyu murhegesi ahamagala Baranaaba na Saawulo baje emwage bulaala alishondere kuyunva eChinwa cha Nnamahanga.
Aliko olaala mukurungu Bara-Yeesu, oyirikwa Elima omu Kigiriki, arhonganya Baranaaba na Saawulo, n'ogushonda kubuza oyo murhegesi arhayemeeraga Yeesu.
Aliko Saawulo, oyirikwa kandi Paawulo, eyi ayunjwizwe Muuka-Mutagatiifu, ava amulola n'ameesho makalihire.
Amubwira ntya: «Ego mugala wa Shetaani, mwanzi wa byooshi bikwaneene! Wooyo oyunjwire na ngasi buuko b'obulyaalya n'obubeeshi. K'orhaluha kulema walenganya oMwazi g'okuli gwa Nnaweerhu?

Leero Nnaweerhu akola aguhana. Waaba mpumi, wanamala siku zilebe buzira kulola obumoleke bw'ezuuba.» Ho n'aho oluhomo n'omwizimya byaaja omu meesho maage. Arhondera kumamaarha omu gushonda omuntu w'okumufarha okuboko y'amuyeereka enjira.
Ola murhegesi abeere abona ebyamajirika, asoomererwa enyigirizo za Nnaweerhu, anamuyemeera.
Paawulo abala oMwazi Mwinja eAntiyokiya y'ePisidiya
Paawulo n'abaliiri nabo baaja omu chombo, barhenga ePafo, baaja omu gishagala ch'ePeriga omu gihugo ch'ePamfiliya. Babeere baagera yo, Yohaana oyirikwa Mariko abaleka, anagaluka eYerusaleema.
Aliko boowe, Gurhengera ePeriga bakomeza olugenzi lwabo, banahika omu gishagala ch'eAntiyokiya
omu gihugo ch'ePisidiya. Olusiku lw'eSaabato baaja omu sinagoogi, banayikala mo.

Enyuma w'ogusomwa kw'ebitaabu by'eRhegeko na eby'abaleebi, abakulu b'esinagoogi babarhumira omuntu ababwire ntya: «Beene beerhu, akonva mugwerhe echinwa ch'ogukomeza abantu omurhima, mujage mwaderha.»
Paawulo aja ayumanga, abasimira n'okuboko mpu basire, n'okubabwira ntya: «Munyunvirize, bantu b'eIsraheeli nenyu mwe bandi muyuubaha Nnamahanga!
Nnamahanga w'olu lubaga lw'eIsraheeli, agishogere bashookuluza beerhu. Abajira kuba lubaga lunene amango balibungiire omu gihugo ch'eMiisiri. Buzinda abakuula yo omu buhashe bwage bunene.
Aliiri kulembera engeso zaabo zibi amango baliiri omu mpinga hoofu myaaka makumi mane.
Abeere amahima embaga mushanvu z'egihugo ch'eKanaana, abaheereza echo gihugo kuba gashambala kaabo.
Ebyoola byooshi byamala hoofu myaaka magana mane na makumi marhaano. «Buzinda bw'aho, abaha abazuuzi, guhika oku muleebi Samweri.
Oku buzinda bahema omwami. Nnamahanga abaha Saawulo, mugala wa Kiisi, w'omu buuko bwa Benjamina, abarhegeke myaaka makumi mane.

Nnamahanga abeere amakuula Saawulo oku bwami, ayimika Daawudi. Oyu Daawudi ye Nnamahanga ahamiirizaga ko ntya: ‹Nabwene Daawudi, mugala wa Yeese, ali muntu omurhima gwani gusiimire; nj'ajira byooshi nshondere ajire.›
Gurhengera omu mulala gw'oyo Daawudi mu Nnamahanga akuulaga Yeesu kuba Muchunguzi wa Israheeli, gukulikirana n'echilagaane chaage.
Embere z'oguhika kwage, Yohaana abwira abantu b'olubaga looshi lw'eIsraheeli baleke ebyaaha, banabatiizwe.

Amango Yohaana abeere akola hoofu kuyuusa omulimo gwage, aliiri aderha ntya: ‹Mukengereere oku nyoono ndi nde? Nyoono ntali oyo muli mwalinga! Aliko ayinjire enyuma zaani, eyi nyoono ntakwaneene chiro gushwekuula emigozi y'ebiraato byaage.›
«Beene beerhu, bantu b'omu mulala gwa Abrahaamu nenyu mweshi b'ezindi mbaga muyuubaha Nnamahanga, echi Chinwa ch'obuchunguke girhumirwe emwerhu.

Kwenge aBanyayerusaleema n'abarhegesi baabo barharhegeeraga Yeesu ali nde. Barhamenyaga ebinwa by'abaleebi bisomwa ngasi lusiku lw'eSaabato. Aliko omu kumuhana baajira nka kulaala aMandiko mali maderhere.
Buzira kubona echagarhumire ahanirwa ogufa, bahema Pilaato amuyirhe.
Babeere baamala kujira byooshi byaliyandikirwe elugulu waage, bamuyandagaza oku musalaaba, banamuhira omu shinda.
Aliko Nnamahanga amufuulire omu bafu.
Abonekeene siku zinene oku bantu bazamuukaga naye gurhenga eGalilaaya kuja eYerusaleema, na bunoola, bo bali bahamiiriza baage oku lubaga lw'eIsraheeli.
Neerhu, rhubabaliire ogu Mwazi Mwinja, oku echilagaane Nnamahanga ahaaga bashookuluza beerhu,
arhujiriire cho rhwe baana baabo, omu gufuula Yeesu. Ogu mwazi guyandikirwe ntya omu chigabi cha kabiri ch'eNanga:
N'elugulu w'ogufuuka kwa Yeesu, y'arhabola, Nnamahanga aderha ntya:
Cho girhumire aderhere ntya omu chindi chigabi ch'aMandiko Matagatiifu:
Daawudi yeewe, abeere amamala gukola gukulikirana n'oku Nnamahanga alirheganyize omu kalamo kaage, afa. Ahambwa ahaburhambi bw'eshinda za b'esheekuluza, anabola.
Aliko olaala Nnamahanga afuulaga, yeewe arhabolaga.

«Beene beerhu, mukwaneene kumenya oku kugerera yeewe, omwazi g'obubabale bw'ebyaaha gwabalirwe emwenyu. Kugerera oyu Yeesu, ngaasi yeeshi omuyemeerere ababalirwa ebyaaha, aliko murhakababalirwe kugerera amarhegeko ma Muusa.
Boboola muchilange y'ebiyandikirwe ntya omu bitaabu by'abaleebi birhabahikira:

content.text: kwenge nyoono, najira ekijiro omu gihe chenyu,
ekijiro murhakayemereere nachiro akaba bakababwirire cho.›»

content: Paawulo na Baranaaba babeere bahuluka omu sinagoogi, abantu babayinginga bashube kuyinja kubabalira eyo myaazi olusiku lw'eSaabato yakulikira.

Enyuma z'enshimaanano, aBayaahudi banene n'abandi bantu b'ezindi mbaga bayemeeraga edini ly'ekiyaahudi n'ogukuuza Nnamahanga, bakulikira Paawulo na Baranaaba. Abo bombi baganiira haguma n'abo bantu, banagendekera gukomeza bo, yi barhaleka guseera omu lukogo lwa Nnamahanga.
Paawulo na Baranaaba bayeerekera emw'abarhali Bayaahudi
Olusiku lw'eSaabato yakulikiraga, hoofu abantu booshi b'egishagala bachigusha haguma kuyunva eChinwa cha Nnaweerhu.
aBayaahudi babeere baabona echo chigusho ch'abantu, bafarhwa n'obongwa bunene. Balahira ebinwa bya Paawulo, banamuhamiiriza obubeeshi.

Paawulo na Baranaaba baaja bababwira ntya buzira buuba: «Byaliiri bya bulagiirire mwabo mwe murhangage mubalirwe eChinwa cha Nnamahanga. Aliko oboola yi mwalahira cho, munali mwachiganja nka mwabo murhakwaneene akalamo k'esiku n'amango, rhwabo rhwayerekera emwa b'abarhali Bayaahudi.
Kwenge Nnaweerhu arhurhegekere ntya:
Abarhali Bayaahudi babeere bayunva eyo myaazi, bamoga. Bakuuza eChinwa cha Nnaweerhu. Na booshi balirheganyizwe akalamo k'esiku n'amango bayemeera Yeesu.
Echinwa cha Nnaweerhu chagenda chayandaala omu gihugo chooshi.
Aliko aBayaahudi bayoohya abakazi bakengerwe, banasiima guharamya Nnamahanga, haguma n'abashamuka b'egishagala. Barhondera kulibuza Paawulo na Baranaaba, banabalibisya omu gihugo chaabo.
Paawulo na Baranaaba babakungurhira k'olujuchu
lw'oku magulu maabo, banachijiira omu gishagala ch'eIkoniyo.
Aliko abemeezi boowe baliyunjwire obushagaluke n'oMuuka-Mutagatiifu.
